title: the 32 GB profile's wake helper is waited on, so up --wait reaches healthy

findings.claim: the 32 GB profile never reached healthy: the last start-up helper judge-wake-init (restart no) was waited on by no service, so docker compose up --wait (install.sh, poc.sh, update, the boot unit) failed on its exit 0; fixed: model-guard waits on it with service_completed_successfully

a docker compose up of the 32 GB stack while a screening run holds the card re-runs the swap chain (sleep judge, sleep verifier, wake judge) and puts the verifier to sleep under the run while the gateway believes it awake
on --gpu rtx4090 (--scale llm-verifier=0) model-swap-init waits for a verifier that is not there and fails after its 600 tries, so judge-wake-init never runs and the stack does not reach healthy
